remarks: This direct waterfront condo has 3 bedroom, 2.5 baths with a one-car attached garage located in East Norwalk's desirable Dorlon Terrace.. Lovely water views as you relax on patio or the two balconies/decks. Conveniently located to pool and clubhouse Improvements include:new wood flooring throughout, updated kitchen with new counters and baclsplash with ample cabinet space, four new Andersen sliders in livingroom and bedrooms, new storm and garage door and new hot water heater. Special assessment of $38,011.40 has been paid in full. Assessement included the installation of all new roofs, siding, gutters, seawall maintenance, new sidewalks and driveways. Dorlon Terrace is conveniently located to public beach and marina, private golf, tennis and beach clubs plus Metro North, SoNo restaurants and entertainment. Dorlon Terrace residents can rent a boat slip.
